description: Tell the ProductClank team a tool failed, returned something that doesn't make sense, or that you're stuck and can't finish the user's task. Free. A human is alerted and replies (read it with get_support_status). Use this INSTEAD of retrying a failing call in a loop — but not for expected guards the error already explains (insufficient credits, a confirmation prompt, a spend cap): relay those to the user. Include the failing tool, its error code/status and what you tried. If the error_code is a known one, the result carries `self_help` — a fix you can apply right away. Tell the user in one line that you reported it. To add detail to an earlier report pass its ticket_id rather than opening a new one.

context.description: Arguments you passed, the error text, what you already tried. Never include secrets.

error_code.description: The machine error code from the failed call, if shown.

http_status.description: Status from the failed call, if shown.

message.description: What you were trying to do, what happened, and what you expected.

severity.description: 'blocking' = you cannot continue the user's task. Default 'normal'.

ticket_id.description: Follow up on a ticket you opened earlier.

tool.description: The ProductClank tool that failed, e.g. generate_posts.

name: report_issue
title: Report an issue to ProductClank support
